issues.display_title: Issue #405: Refactor Device, Post Register, and Cron Exec Queries
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 24/07/26

✅ Implementation: Refactor Device, Post Register, and Cron Exec Queries

This document tracks the execution details for this non-worker Exec refactor.

Phase 1: Device Endpoint

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Additional/Device.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models, uuid, and time imports.
    • Replaced dynamic INSERT INTO device string building with Config.DB.Create(&Models.Device{...}).
    • Replaced dynamic UPDATE device string building with Config.DB.Model(&Models.Device{}).Where(...).Updates(...).
    • Preserved mobile_device vs browser branching and lowercase normalization.
  • Status: Completed.

Phase 2: Register Panorama Name

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/RegisterPanoramaName.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced Exec UPDATE posts with Config.DB.Model(&Models.Post{}).Where(...).Updates(...).
    • Preserved Redis panorama status updates, request validation, response payload, and status code.
  • Status: Completed.

Phase 3: Embed Cron Pending Updates

  • Target Files:
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckEmbedYoutube.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckEmbedVillume.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckEmbedTourmkr.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models imports.
    • Replaced Exec UPDATE posts SET pending = false WHERE slug = ? with Config.DB.Model(&Models.Post{}).Where("slug = ?", slug).Update("pending", false).
    • Preserved external validation flow and Redis embed refresh behavior.
  • Status: Completed.

Phase 4: Invalid Google Token Cron

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckInvalidTokenGoogle.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced Exec UPDATE street_views_account SET is_active = false WHERE id = ? with Config.DB.Model(&Models.StreetViewsAccount{}).Where(...).Update(...).
    • Preserved OAuth refresh-token validation behavior and error response.
  • Status: Completed.

Phase 5: Message New Posts Cron

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/MessageNewPosts.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced bulk Exec UPDATE user_detail with Config.DB.Model(&Models.UserDetail{}).Where("user_id IN ?", collectId).Updates(...).
    • Preserved Centrifugo publish flow and log-only update error handling.
  • Status: Completed.

Verification

  • Ran gofmt on all modified Go files.
  • Ran:
go test ./src/Action/V1/Additional ./src/Action/V1/Posts ./src/Action/V1/Cronjob
  • Result: passed, packages reported no test files.
  • Ran scoped raw SQL scan:
rg -n "Config\.DB\.Exec\(" src\Action\V1\Additional\Device.go src\Action\V1\Posts\RegisterPanoramaName.go src\Action\V1\Cronjob\CheckEmbedYoutube.go src\Action\V1\Cronjob\CheckEmbedVillume.go src\Action\V1\Cronjob\CheckEmbedTourmkr.go src\Action\V1\Cronjob\CheckInvalidTokenGoogle.go src\Action\V1\Cronjob\MessageNewPosts.go
  • Result: no matches.

Notes

  • No worker files were touched in this batch.

Background

Several non-worker endpoints and cron handlers still use Config.DB.Exec for simple insert and update queries. These can use existing GORM models without changing endpoint signatures or response behavior.

Objective

Replace scoped non-worker Exec calls with GORM model operations.

Scope

  • src/Action/V1/Additional/Device.go
    • Replace dynamic device insert/update Exec calls.
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/RegisterPanoramaName.go
    • Replace post metadata/uploading update Exec call.
  • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckEmbedYoutube.go
    • Replace posts.pending update Exec call.
  • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckEmbedVillume.go
    • Replace posts.pending update Exec call.
  • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckEmbedTourmkr.go
    • Replace posts.pending update Exec call.
  • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckInvalidTokenGoogle.go
    • Replace street_views_account.is_active update Exec call.
  • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/MessageNewPosts.go
    • Replace bulk user_detail update Exec call.

Constraints

  • Do not touch any file under src/Worker.
  • Do not change function signatures.
  • Do not change response payloads or status codes.
  • Do not change Redis, RabbitMQ, ElasticSearch, or external HTTP behavior.
  • Do not refactor unrelated raw SQL.

Acceptance Criteria

  • No Config.DB.Exec( remains in the scoped files.
  • Device still inserts when no matching device row exists and updates when one exists.
  • RegisterPanoramaName still sets panorama Redis statuses before DB update.
  • Embed cron handlers still set pending = false only after external validation succeeds.
  • CheckInvalidTokenGoogle still deactivates invalid Street View accounts.
  • MessageNewPosts still resets new_posts, queue_new_posts, and timeline_update for collected users.
  • Verification passes with:
go test ./src/Action/V1/Additional ./src/Action/V1/Posts ./src/Action/V1/Cronjob

issues.display_title: Issue #406: Refactor Post Edit/Update Queries to GORM (Batch A)
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 24/07/26

✅ Implementation: Refactor Post Edit/Update Queries to GORM

This document tracks the execution details for the Batch A non-worker Exec refactor.

Phase 1: Edit Post Description

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/EditPostDescription.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced dynamic UPDATE posts string building with a map[string]interface{} fed to Config.DB.Model(&Models.Post{}).Where("id = ?", postId).Updates(...).
    • Preserved conditional visibility field: added to the map only when a valid visibility form value is present.
  • Status: Completed.

Phase 2: Edit Post Panorama

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/EditPostPanorama.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced 6 Exec calls:
      • little_planet_filter update → Model(&Models.LittlePlanetFilter{}).Where("id = ?", filterIdStr).Updates(...).
      • animation_post update → Model(&Models.AnimationPost{}).Where("id = ?", animationIdStr).Update("animation_value", ...).
      • multiple_post (little planet + animation) update → Model(&Models.MultiplePost{}).Where("id = ?", multipleIdStr).Updates(...).
      • posts thumbnail-default update → Model(&Models.Post{}).Where("id = ?", postId).Updates(...).
      • multiple_post default_thumb = false where post_id → Update("default_thumb", false).
      • multiple_post default_thumb = true where id → Update("default_thumb", true).
    • Preserved branch conditions, JSON/fiber.Map values passed as-is, and error responses.
  • Status: Completed.

Phase 3: Update Post Video

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/UpdatePostVideo.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced little_planet_filter update → Model(&Models.LittlePlanetFilter{}).Where("post_id = ?", postId).Updates(...).
    • Replaced dynamic posts update → Model(&Models.Post{}).Where("id = ?", postId).Updates(...).
    • Preserved conditional little_planet_filter: nil when no filter, filter map otherwise. Map-based Updates still writes the nil as NULL, matching the original bind.
  • Status: Completed.

Phase 4: Update Draft Image

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Additional/UpdateDraftImage.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced DELETE FROM multiple_post WHERE id = ? → Config.DB.Where("id = ?", id).Delete(&Models.MultiplePost{}).
    • Replaced multiple_post thumbnail/qualities update → Model(&Models.MultiplePost{}).Where("id = ?", id).Updates(...).
    • Replaced posts thumbnail/quality update → Model(&Models.Post{}).Where("id = ?", id).Updates(...).
    • Preserved file-existence delete-then-continue flow and per-iteration error logging.
  • Status: Completed.

Verification

  • Ran:
go build ./src/Action/V1/Posts ./src/Action/V1/Additional
go vet ./src/Action/V1/Posts ./src/Action/V1/Additional
go test ./src/Action/V1/Posts ./src/Action/V1/Additional
  • Result: build and vet clean; test reported no test files for these packages.
  • Ran scoped raw SQL scan:

Background

Several post edit/update endpoints still use Config.DB.Exec for scoped update and delete queries, including dynamically-built UPDATE statements. These map to existing GORM models without changing endpoint signatures or response behavior.

Objective

Replace scoped Exec calls in the Batch A files with GORM model operations. Preserve conditional field building (columns only added to the update when their form value is present).

Scope

  • src/Action/V1/Posts/EditPostDescription.go
    • Replace dynamic posts update Exec (line ~166). Build a map[string]interface{} with description, location_name, location_post, category_id, updated_at, and conditionally visibility, then Updates.
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/EditPostPanorama.go
    • Replace 6 Exec calls: little_planet_filter update (~139), animation_post update (~178), multiple_post update (~243), posts update (~326), two multiple_post updates (~356, ~372).
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/UpdatePostVideo.go
    • Replace little_planet_filter update (~140) and dynamic posts update (~193).
  • src/Action/V1/Additional/UpdateDraftImage.go
    • Replace multiple_post DELETE (~69), multiple_post update (~175), posts update (~189).

Models

  • Models.Post → posts
  • Models.MultiplePost → multiple_post
  • Models.AnimationPost → animation_post
  • Models.LittlePlanetFilter → little_planet_filter

Constraints

  • Do not touch any file under src/Worker.
  • Do not change function signatures.
  • Do not change response payloads or status codes.
  • Do not change Redis, RabbitMQ, ElasticSearch, or external HTTP behavior.
  • Do not refactor unrelated raw SQL (Add*/Upload*/DeletePost are Batch B).
  • Use map-based Updates or column-explicit Update so false/0 zero values still write.
  • Keep conditional column building: fields only present in the map when their source value is set.

Acceptance Criteria

  • No Config.DB.Exec( remains in the 4 scoped files.
  • EditPostDescription still adds visibility to the update only when a valid visibility form value is provided.
  • EditPostPanorama still updates little planet, animation, multiple_post, and posts in the same branches as before.
  • UpdatePostVideo still updates the little planet filter and the post video fields.
  • UpdateDraftImage still deletes existing multiple_post rows before re-inserting/updating.
  • Verification passes with:
go build ./src/Action/V1/Posts ./src/Action/V1/Additional
go test ./src/Action/V1/Posts ./src/Action/V1/Additional

issues.display_title: Issue #407: Refactor Post Add/Upload/Delete Queries to GORM (Batch B)
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 24/07/26

✅ Implementation: Refactor Post Add/Upload/Delete Queries to GORM (Batch B)

This document tracks the execution details for the Batch B non-worker Exec refactor.

Phase 1: Panorama Upload Inserts

  • Target Files:
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/UploadPanoramaDbx.go
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/UploadPanoramaGDrive.go
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/UploadPanoramaPost.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced INSERT INTO multiple_post with Config.DB.Model(&Models.MultiplePost{}).Create(map[string]interface{}{...}).
    • Dbx keeps its dropbox column; GDrive/Post use their respective path/size sources.
    • Preserved temp-file removal on insert failure.
  • Status: Completed.

Phase 2: Delete Post

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/DeletePost.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced 5 DELETE Exec calls with Config.DB.Where(...).Delete(&Models.X{}):
      • bucket_containers (both branches) → Delete(&Models.BucketContainers{}).
      • notifications → Delete(&Models.Notifications{}).
      • posts → Delete(&Models.Post{}).
      • collection_post → Delete(&Models.CollectionPost{}).
    • Preserved all conditional guards (bucket existence, notification existence, orphan collection check).
  • Status: Completed.

Phase 3: Add Post Gothru

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostGothru.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced bucket_containers INSERT and multiple_post INSERT with map-based Create.
  • Status: Completed.

Phase 4: Add Post

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPost.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models and gorm.io/gorm/clause imports.
    • bucket_containers INSERT → map Create.
    • little_planet_filter upsert (×2) → Clauses(clause.OnConflict{Columns: post_id, DoUpdates: filter_type/filter_value}).Create(...).
    • animation_post upsert (×2) → Clauses(clause.OnConflict{Columns: post_id, DoUpdates: animation_value}).Create(...).
    • multiple_post INSERT → map Create.
    • posts UPDATE → map Updates.
  • Status: Completed.

Phase 5: Add Post Complete

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostComplete.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models import.
    • multiple_post UPDATE (WHERE id AND post_id) → chained Where + map Updates.
    • Dynamic posts UPDATE → map Updates; created_at added to the map only when action == "publish".
  • Status: Completed.

Phase 6: Add Post Complete Embed

  • Target File:
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostCompleteEmbed.go
  • Changes Applied:
    • Added Models and gorm.io/gorm/clause imports.
    • Dynamic posts UPDATE (incl. conditional affiliate_id and created_at) → map Updates.
    • little_planet_filter and animation_post upserts → clause.OnConflict Create.
  • Status: Completed.

Verification

  • Ran:
go build ./src/Action/V1/Posts
go vet ./src/Action/V1/Posts
go test ./src/Action/V1/Posts
  • Result: build and vet clean; test reported no test files for the package.
  • Ran scoped raw SQL scan (Config.DB.Exec() over all 8 files: no matches.

Background

The remaining post creation, panorama upload, and delete endpoints still use Config.DB.Exec for insert, update, upsert (ON CONFLICT), and delete queries. These map to existing GORM models without changing endpoint signatures or response behavior.

Objective

Replace scoped Exec calls in the Batch B files with GORM model operations. Preserve ON CONFLICT (post_id) DO UPDATE semantics via clause.OnConflict, and preserve conditional field building.

Scope

  • src/Action/V1/Posts/UploadPanoramaDbx.go
    • Replace multiple_post INSERT (with dropbox) → Create map.
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/UploadPanoramaGDrive.go
    • Replace multiple_post INSERT → Create map.
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/UploadPanoramaPost.go
    • Replace multiple_post INSERT → Create map.
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/DeletePost.go
    • Replace 5 DELETEs: bucket_containers (×2), notifications, posts, collection_post → Delete.
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostGothru.go
    • Replace bucket_containers INSERT and multiple_post INSERT → Create maps.
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPost.go
    • Replace 7 Exec: bucket_containers INSERT, little_planet_filter upsert (×2), animation_post upsert (×2), multiple_post INSERT, posts UPDATE.
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostComplete.go
    • Replace multiple_post UPDATE and dynamic posts UPDATE (conditional created_at).
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostCompleteEmbed.go
    • Replace dynamic posts UPDATE (conditional created_at), little_planet_filter upsert, animation_post upsert.

Models

  • Models.Post → posts
  • Models.MultiplePost → multiple_post
  • Models.BucketContainers → bucket_containers
  • Models.LittlePlanetFilter → little_planet_filter
  • Models.AnimationPost → animation_post
  • Models.Notifications → notifications
  • Models.CollectionPost → collection_post

Constraints

  • Do not touch any file under src/Worker.
  • Do not change function signatures, response payloads, or status codes.
  • Do not change Redis, RabbitMQ, ElasticSearch, Minio, or external HTTP behavior.
  • INSERTs use map-based Create so DB defaults still fill id/created_at/updated_at (struct Create would send zero UUID/time).
  • Upserts use clause.OnConflict{Columns: post_id, DoUpdates: ...} to keep exact ON CONFLICT behavior.
  • Updates use map-based Updates so false/0/nil still write.

Acceptance Criteria

  • No Config.DB.Exec( remains in the 8 scoped files.
  • Upload endpoints still insert one multiple_post row per upload and remove the temp file on insert failure.
  • DeletePost still deletes bucket, notification, post, and orphan collection rows in the same conditional branches.
  • AddPost/AddPostCompleteEmbed upserts still update filter_type/filter_value and animation_value on post_id conflict.
  • AddPostComplete/AddPostCompleteEmbed still add created_at to the post update only when action == "publish".
  • Verification passes with:
go build ./src/Action/V1/Posts
go vet ./src/Action/V1/Posts
go test ./src/Action/V1/Posts
